nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Wow Polish Triple Pore-Exfoliating Powder

segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin found this exfoliator effective at deep exfoliation without the irritation she gets from other physical scrubs.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin report it as gentle enough for regular or even daily use, though two separate reviewers object to the added fragrance on principle for skin that has issues.

concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or dry skin describe this powder as gentler than other physical exfoliants, causing less irritation than products like a rough microdermabrasion scrub; one reviewer with unspecified skin instead noticed new indentations in her skin after use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her pores looked less noticeable after use, per an in-store recommendation to massage it in circular motions for several minutes.

extraits.texte: I used this and my sister noticed that I had more indentations in my skin than usual.

I would love this if it did not have unnecessary ingredients, such as fragrance & artificial colors. I just don't feel good about scrubbing that into my skin. Come on Benefit Cosmetics! Those ingredients are unnecessary. You are wasting your own money by putting those ingredients in your products.

I thought these would be microdermabrasion type crystals, and would be much more fine. Instead this is a "st.ives apricot scrub" type product, but you have to add the liquid (water). Think of it as a dehydrated food product you hydrate yourself, like instant mashed potatoes but skin care. Thats not what most people who spend 50 dollars on this think they're getting- people are expecting a very, very fine powder. I can get the very fine type powder I'm referring to for much less money than this product cost. Other brands make a similar dehydrated skin care product you can get for 30 dollars less. I rarely feel duped by a product but this is just so expensive for what it is. The grains of this powder are huge, even with the stick they include to mix the powder the powder is not fine, at all. And it has fragrance in it to, which no one who has actual skin issues wants in a product- actually I dont understand why any brand for people with problem skin continues to puts perfume or fragrance. I kept the box but I dont think I can return an opened product so I'm leaving this review to help others instead. I can spend 20 less dollars getting 2 separate products: genuinely fine exfoliating powder and a separate chemical exfoliating product, and it will be more effective and less likely to irritate.

I love this exfoliator. I have dry, sensitive skin and it is extremely challenging to find an exfoliator that doesnt irritate my skin while providing the deep exfoliation I crave. The concept of creating your exfoliator, is my favorite. I loved Microfoliant by Dermalogica, but never could get over the rough physical texture and the irriation it caused. This powder is smooth yet effective and the chemical exfoliators get the next-level, smoothing exfoliation without the irriation! New obsession and staple to my skincare regimen!
I loved how gentle this was, I can use this every day to remove peeling and dead skin. I normally have very sensitive skin.

I didn't get the employees name but she recommended this product when I asked where the pore section would be. She said I should lather and do circular motions for 3-5 mins. Face changer. My face felt extremely clean and couldn't notice my pores as much

I love this exfoliating powder. My skin looks clean and not over scrubbed. I wish it didnt smell like blueberrys or the fruity scent it has. But the bottle has a generous amount of powder. I recommend wetting face and rubbing the powder into wet face.

reserve: The sample is small (10 reviews, two duplicates) and most do not specify skin type, so segment-level conclusions rest on very few individual accounts.
